smallStepsBody: A little curiosity goes a long way.
helpBody: Choose Library to find a book. Open a book to add it to your reading list. Explore has small activities you can try with a facilitator. Ask an EVG volunteer if you need help.
demo: Design preview · Fictional examples · Changes reset on refresh
footer: Made for curious minds. Growing together with EVG.
homeTitle: A new day, a new discovery.
homeBody: Pick up a book. Follow your curiosity. Learn at your own pace.
atYourPace: There is a whole world in the little things. Keep exploring, one page at a time.
physicalReading: Read your physical book, then record your progress here.
goalBody: Try this example goal with an EVG volunteer.
goalTask: Share one thing I learned from a book
goalEncourage: No rush. A little progress is enough.
educatorPicks: Example shelf · In future, chosen by EVG educators
noRush: Every book is a new beginning.
sampleBook: Fictional book for this preview. No digital book file is included. Reading time is an example.
askStaff: Ask an EVG volunteer to borrow a physical copy.
libraryBody: Browse a book, see what is available, and find something you enjoy.
trySearch: Try another word or show all books.
loanNote: Sample loan. A volunteer records borrowing and returns. Your reading list is separate.
exploreBody: Start with one question. You do not need to know the answer yet.
editorial: Sample activities for everyone. These are not personalised recommendations.
interestsBody: Choose any topics you like. You can change your mind whenever you want.
recommendationsBody: For now, browse freely. Later, EVG can use your interests to suggest reviewed topics. AI will only be considered after simple recommendations prove insufficient.
communityBody: Discover what sharing our learning could look like. These are fictional examples.
fictionalWork: Example work · Not a real student submission
sharingBody: Sharing projects, comments, and rewards will come later, with an EVG review process and a named moderator. Nothing can be published from this preview.
staffBody: Try one sample circulation task. This open preview has no account protection and contains no real student records.
staffLoanNote: This updates the sample availability in Library. It does not mark the book as read. Due dates, permission checks, lost copies, and real records are future work.
operationsLater: More tools, one step at a time
operationsBody: Catalogue editing, learner accounts, moderation queues, exports, and recovery tools remain planned. First, validate these screens with EVG staff.
signInPreview: Explore the EVG design preview. Accounts will be added later; please do not enter personal information.

nature.title: How does a seed grow?
nature.body: Notice the small changes in the plants around you.
nature.instruction: Look at a plant with a volunteer. Draw its leaves and describe one thing you notice. Do not taste unknown plants.

stories.title: Every place has a story.
stories.body: Imagine a new adventure in a familiar place.
stories.instruction: Choose an imaginary character. Tell a volunteer where they go, who they meet, and one kind thing they do.

science.title: What makes a bridge strong?
science.body: Explore shapes using a little paper and curiosity.
science.instruction: With a volunteer, fold a sheet of paper and rest it across two books. Compare a flat sheet with a folded sheet. Use only light paper objects.

garden.title: Our little leaf journal
garden.body: An example of noticing different leaf shapes and drawing what changes each day.

bridge.title: One sheet, many possibilities
bridge.body: An example paper bridge project: try a shape, notice what happens, and try again.
